purpose: Name the exact source set the re-frozen six-bank mixture selects, so the source-use decision has a closed list to range over. Selection is not admission: the family, correctness, finite-supply and runtime gates stay open per source in experiments/main-data/source-readiness.json.
selection_basis: Derived from experiments/main-data/plan.json main_pretraining.mixture after the 2026-09-22 six-bank re-freeze.
field_note: tokenizer_sample_allocations is the field name speck.data.rights requires for the list a rights template must range over. Here it carries the selected source set rather than a tokenizer sampling budget, and its order fixes decision order.

not_selected.checked_code: Bank dropped in the 2026-09-22 re-freeze with zero retained stock and no verified origin join. No source-use decision is required for a source the mixture does not select.
not_selected.nemotron_cc_math_4plus: All 46 listed objects have unusable hashes and no shard was ever acquired, so there is nothing to decide about.
not_selected.ultradata_math_l2_preview: Not selected. All 169,058 retained rows lack host metadata, so no per-document attribution manifest can be produced for it, and no dataset card or licence text for it is pinned in the rights evidence. Its tokens were never counted toward the math bank. Retained as a candidate for a future revised freeze if host lineage is recovered.
